title: The exhausting hike
content: I’m running out of specific dream locations to post about but frequently (and more so recently) I’ve been having reoccurring dreams that require me to travel long distances by foot.. so I wanted to talk about them. There’s this place I travel to that connects my mall world to another suburban area that usually “requires” me to walk. It’s a long windy trail through a mountainside. I never question why I’m walking, where my car is or WHY I need to finish the trek- I just know I have to if that makes sense. There must be enormous symbolism surrounding these dreams.. if I had to guess: possibly something about overcoming hurdles and obstacles in my current life (which would make sense given things going on recently IRL). I had a similar dream last night where I was at a random hotel and traveled quite a distance from my hotel via some sort of boat in a narrow body of water. I eventually hopped off the boat and wanted to return to my hotel. Again, I felt forced to travel by foot despite the many cars, buses and bikes that I saw. The venture back was less than easy. Almost like a video game where I had to pick the best route to avoid any “traps”. These dreams are exhausting and quite frustrating. Can anyone else relate?
